I just think you can’t have it until there’s a reason for liquidity conditions to be looser.”⁣ ⁣ That means waiting on the AI trade to unwind, or stocks dropping enough to force the printers back on.⁣ ⁣ “Do we really want our grocery bills to double up just so we can have a few months where crypto is doing well?”⁣ ⁣ Be careful what you wish for. 🎬⁣ ⁣ #Bitcoin #Altseason #Crypto #Liquidity #CryptoNews
